component.name: Hejjetrac
component.summary: Track spherical treadmills and record laboratory experiments

description.p: Hejjetrac measures the rotation of a patterned ball for animal locomotion experiments. Its native desktop provides live camera previews, guided ball and laboratory-axis calibration, trajectory inspection and independent rigs.

ul.li: Record source video, diagnostic video and complete numerical and quality data.
Align tracking and virtual reality using per-frame wall-clock metadata and trial tags.
Start and stop recordings from another computer through authenticated remote control.
Send motion to experiment software over UDP or ZeroMQ.
Use one unbound camera on first launch; configure and optionally bind multi-camera rigs.

description.p: This package includes the desktop, command-line tools, an illustrated manual, sample video and dependency notices. No compiler or Python runtime is required. Calibrate your own camera before collecting measurements.
Based on FicTrac by R. J. D. Moore and collaborators. Scientific validation, supported codecs and platform limitations are documented in the manual.
